title_en: Zhejiang Hexin Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. and Jinhua Daxing Materials Co., Ltd. v. Tonghe Real Estate Investment Co., Ltd., Guangsha Holdings Venture Capital Co., Ltd., Shanghai Fuwo Enterprise Development Co., Ltd., and Third Party Tonghe Investment Holdings Co., Ltd. — dispute over infringement of company rights and interests
ruling_gist_en: After a shareholder of a limited liability company initiates a shareholder representative litigation against the company's directors, supervisors, senior management personnel, or other persons in accordance with Article 152 of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, if the parties to the litigation reach a mediation agreement presided over by the People's Court, such mediation agreement must not only be unanimously agreed upon by all parties to the litigation, but also must obtain the consent of the company in which the shareholder initiating the shareholder representative litigation holds shares and of other shareholders of the company who did not participate in the litigation. Only then can the People's Court finally confirm the legal effect of the mediation agreement.

full_text_en:
Zhejiang Hexin Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. and Jinhua Daxing Materials Co., Ltd. v. Tonghe Zhiye Investment Co., Ltd., Guangxia Holding Venture Capital Co., Ltd., Shanghai Fuwo Enterprise Development Co., Ltd., and Third Party Tonghe Investment Holding Co., Ltd. — Dispute over Damage to Company Rights and Interests

[Ruling Summary]

Where, in accordance with Article 152 of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, a shareholder of a limited liability company initiates a shareholder representative lawsuit against the company's directors, supervisors, senior management personnel, or other persons, and after the proceedings, a mediation agreement is reached among the litigating parties with the mediation of the People's Court, the mediation agreement shall not only be unanimously agreed upon by all litigating parties, but must also be consented to by the company in which the shareholder initiating the shareholder representative lawsuit holds shares and by other shareholders of the company who did not participate in the lawsuit, before the People's Court can ultimately confirm the legal validity of the mediation agreement.

Civil Mediation Decision of the Supreme People's Court
(2008) Min Er Zhong Zi No. 123

Appellants (Plaintiffs at First Instance): Zhejiang Hexin Electric Power Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 368, Jiangbin Middle Road, Yiwu City, Zhejiang Province.
Legal Representative: Zeng Hanquan, Chairman of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Pan Canjun, lawyer of Zhejiang Yufeng Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Fang Jun, lawyer of Zhejiang Kaifu Law Firm.

Appellants (Plaintiffs at First Instance): Jinhua Daxing Materials Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 147, Qingchun Road, Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province.
Responsible Person: Fang Yuelin, Executive Director of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Pan Canjun, lawyer of Zhejiang Yufeng Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Fang Jun, lawyer of Zhejiang Kaifu Law Firm.

Appellants (Defendants at First Instance): Tonghe Zhiye Investment Co., Ltd., domiciled at 8th Floor, Tower B, World Trade Center, No. 15 Shuguang Road, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province.
Legal Representative: Wang Xiaoming, Chairman of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Yu Yongxiang, lawyer of Zhejiang Tiance Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Yao Keli, Staff Member of the Company.

Appellants (Defendants at First Instance): Guangxia Holding Venture Capital Co., Ltd., domiciled at 3rd Floor, No. 166 Yugu Road, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province.
Legal Representative: Lou Zhongfu, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Yao Keli, Staff Member of the Company.

Defendant at First Instance: Shanghai Fuwo Enterprise Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room 401, No. 335 Changli Road, Pudong, Shanghai.
Legal Representative: Jin Jianzhong, Executive Director of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Dai Xihua, Employee of the Company.

Third Party at First Instance: Tonghe Investment Holding Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 588, Bayi South Street, Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province.
Legal Representative: Zeng Yongqiang, Chairman of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Chen Zongxia, lawyer of Beijing Junzejun Law Firm.

The Appellants Zhejiang Hexin Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hexin Company) and Jinhua Daxing Materials Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Daxing Company) appealed to this Court against the civil judgment rendered by the Zhejiang High People's Court in the case (2007) Zhe Min Er Chu Zi No. 5, involving a dispute over damage to company rights and interests with the Appellants Tonghe Zhiye Investment Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tonghe Zhiye), Guangxia Holding Venture Capital Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Guangxia Venture), the Defendant at First Instance Shanghai Fuwo Enterprise Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Fuwo Company), and the Third Party at First Instance Tonghe Investment Holding Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tonghe Holding). This Court formed a collegial panel composed of Presiding Judge Jin Jianfeng, Acting Judges Yin Yuan and Pan Yongfeng to hear the case. Clerk Bai Xue served as court recorder. The case is now concluded.

Facts Found by the Court of First Instance:

Tonghe Holding was established on April 30, 1999, with a registered capital of RMB 680 million. Among the shareholders, Hexin Company contributed RMB 50 million, accounting for 7.35% of the capital; Daxing Company contributed RMB 18.3 million, accounting for 2.69%; Shenzhen Hengxin Dewei Industrial Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hengxin Company) contributed RMB 348.24 million, accounting for 51.21%; and Zhejiang Guangsha Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Guangsha Share) contributed RMB 125 million, accounting for 18.38%.

Tonghe Zhiye was a limited liability company established on June 13, 2002, in which Tonghe Holding held 95% of the equity and Jinhua Jinwei Property Rights Management Service Co., Ltd. (the former name of Hengxin Company; on November 12, 2004, the company moved from Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province to Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province for registration, and its enterprise name was changed to Hengxin Company) held 5% of the equity.

On September 15, 2004, Tonghe Holding respectively entered into equity transfer agreements with Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Hengxin Company, transferring 35% and 30% of its equity in Tonghe Zhiye. On September 17 of the same year, Tonghe Zhiye went through the registration change procedures with the local administrative department for industry and commerce. Thereafter, Hengxin Company and Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. each held 35% of the equity in Tonghe Zhiye, and Tonghe Holding held 30%.

On December 21, 2004, with Hengxin Company, Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd., and Tonghe Holding as the equity transferors, Fuwo Company and Zhejiang Jinke Industrial Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jinke Company) as the equity transferees, and Tonghe Zhiye as the third party, a framework agreement for the equity transfer of Tonghe Zhiye was signed, stipulating: The equity transferors agreed to transfer all their equities in Tonghe Zhiye to the equity transferees. Specifically, Hengxin Company would transfer its 35% equity in Tonghe Zhiye to Fuwo Company; Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. would transfer its 5% equity in Tonghe Zhiye to Fuwo Company and its 30% equity to Jinke Company; Tonghe Holding would transfer its 30% equity in Tonghe Zhiye to Jinke Company. Upon completion of this equity transfer, the equity structure and shareholder register of Tonghe Zhiye would change as follows: Fuwo Company held 40% equity, and Jinke Company held 60% equity. The total consideration receivable by the equity transferors for transferring the equity of Tonghe Zhiye in accordance with the obligations under this agreement was RMB 600 million, consisting of two parts: an equity transfer price of RMB 350 million for the transfer of all equities of Tonghe Zhiye by the equity transferors to the equity transferees, and a project profit compensation payment of RMB 250 million receivable by the equity transferors from Tonghe Zhiye. Among this, Fuwo Company should pay an equity transfer price of RMB 140 million, of which RMB 122.5 million was payable to Tonghe Holding, with RMB 30 million to be paid within 10 working days after the effective signing of the equity transfer contract, and the balance to be paid within 150 working days. RMB 17.5 million was payable to Hengxin Company, with RMB 10 million to be paid within 10 working days after the effective signing of the equity transfer contract, and the balance to be paid within 150 working days.

On the same day, Tonghe Holding respectively entered into agreements to rescind the equity transfer agreements with Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Hengxin Company, both stipulating that because Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Hengxin Company had not paid the equity transfer price as agreed, the parties agreed to rescind the equity transfer agreements; the rights and obligations under the equity subject matter were all assumed by Tonghe Holding, and Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Hengxin Company no longer enjoyed the rights or bore the obligations of the equity. Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Hengxin Company undertook that after Tonghe Holding found a transferee, they would, pursuant to Tonghe Holding's written authorization, sign an equity transfer agreement with the transferee designated by Tonghe Holding, transferring the equity at the price and payment method designated by Tonghe Holding, with all proceeds paid into the bank account designated by Tonghe Holding.

On the same day, Tonghe Holding respectively executed powers of attorney with Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Hengxin Company, authorizing Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. to transfer its 30% equity in Tonghe Zhiye to Shanghai Banglian Technology Industrial Co., Ltd. and its 5% equity to Fuwo Company, and authorizing Hengxin Company to transfer its 35% equity in Tonghe Zhiye to Fuwo Company.

On the same day, Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. respectively entered into equity transfer agreements with Shanghai Banglian Technology Industrial Co., Ltd. and Fuwo Company, transferring 30% equity in Tonghe Zhiye to Shanghai Banglian Technology Industrial Co., Ltd. and 5% equity to Fuwo Company, with the transfer price for Fuwo Company being RMB 17.5 million. Hengxin Company entered into an equity transfer agreement with Fuwo Company, transferring 35% equity at a transfer price of RMB 122.5 million. Tonghe Holding respectively entered into equity transfer agreements with Jinke Company and Shanghai Banglian Technology Industrial Co., Ltd., transferring 10% and 20% equity to the two companies, respectively. On the day the agreements were signed, Shanghai City Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Hengxin Company respectively issued payment entrustment letters to the transferees, requiring the equity transfer payments to be credited to Tonghe Holding's account.

After the agreements were signed, Fuwo Company paid RMB 45 million to Tonghe Holding on December 24, 2004. On June 23, 2005, Tonghe Holding, Fuwo Company, and Hengxin Company signed a repayment agreement, stipulating: The three parties confirmed that the principal debt amount payable by Fuwo Company to Tonghe Holding was RMB 95 million, of which RMB 77.5 million was the unpaid equity transfer price payable by Fuwo Company to Tonghe Holding, and RMB 17.5 million was a debt payable by Fuwo Company to Tonghe Holding through account adjustment. The three parties agreed that the RMB 17.5 million payable but unpaid by Fuwo Company would be paid directly by Fuwo Company to Tonghe Holding, and Tonghe Holding would simultaneously reduce Fuwo Company's debt to Tonghe Holding by the same amount. Fuwo Company would repay RMB 5 million of the principal debt before June 30, 2005, repay RMB 45 million of the principal debt before June 30, 2006, and pay a capital usage fee to Tonghe Holding at an annual interest rate of 8.5% from July 1, 2005. It would repay the remaining principal debt of RMB 45 million before December 31, 2006, and pay a capital usage fee to Tonghe Holding at an annual interest rate of 8.5% from July 1, 2005. The capital usage fee would be paid together with the corresponding principal in a lump sum. On June 22 and June 29, 2005, Fuwo Company paid Tonghe Holding RMB 3.5 million and RMB 1.5 million, respectively.

In January 2006, after being examined and approved by the administrative department for industry and commerce, the equity of Tonghe Zhiye was legally changed to: Guangxia Venture holding 50% equity, Dongyang Jiangnan Real Estate Co., Ltd. holding 40% equity, and Jinke Company holding 10% equity. On February 28, 2006, Tonghe Holding passed the second extraordinary shareholders' resolution of 2006, adopting the "Proposal on Entrusting Guangxia Venture to Recover Part of the Company's Accounts Receivable," agreeing that Guangxia Venture would fully exercise Tonghe Holding's creditor rights, recover on behalf of Tonghe Holding the profit compensation payment of RMB 159.125 million from Tonghe Zhiye and the outstanding debt of RMB 72.5 million and interest from Fuwo Company for the transfer of equity in Tonghe Zhiye, and Tonghe Holding would no longer exercise such rights. In October 2006, after another change of registration, Guangxia Venture held 100% equity in Tonghe Zhiye. On November 7, 2006, Tonghe Holding issued a payment entrustment letter to Guangxia Venture, requesting Guangxia Venture to directly pay the RMB 51.12 million collected as the equity transfer payment from Fuwo Company to Zhejiang University Bio-tech Co., Ltd. On November 10 of the same year, as the payer, Guangxia Venture paid RMB 51.12 million to that company. On January 12 and March 2, 2007, Guangxia Venture respectively issued demand letters to Tonghe Zhiye, demanding that Tonghe Zhiye pay the profit compensation payment of RMB 159.125 million owed to Tonghe Holding. On March 12 and April 16, 2007, shareholders of Tonghe Holding, including Hexin Company and Daxing Company, respectively sent to Tonghe Holding the "Letter Demanding that the Company Immediately Recover Misappropriated Funds and Transferred Projects through Litigation" and the "Urgent Demand Letter Demanding that the Company Immediately Recover Receivables through Litigation to Safeguard the Company's and Shareholders' Legitimate Rights and Interests," demanding that the company bring lawsuits against Guangxia Venture, Tonghe Zhiye, and Fuwo Company to recover the company's huge receivables, and recover the equity transfer price and dividends of Bengbu New District Development Co., Ltd. allegedly embezzled by Guangxia Venture. On April 17, 2007, Xu Quan, President of Tonghe Holding, replied in writing to Hexin Company and Daxing Company, stating that due to the current state of the company and the approval procedures for using the company seal, the company was unable to file lawsuits as demanded by the shareholders to recover the company's huge receivables from Tonghe Zhiye, Fuwo Company, and Guangxia Venture.

On April 25, 2007, Hexin Company and Daxing Company jointly filed a lawsuit with the court of first instance, requesting the following: (1) That Tonghe Zhiye immediately pay Tonghe Holding a profit compensation payment of RMB 237.5 million and interest of RMB 10.4971 million; (2) That Fuwo Company immediately pay Tonghe Holding an equity transfer payment of RMB 90 million and interest of RMB 14.195 million; (3) That the authorization granted by Tonghe Holding to Guangxia Venture for entrusted collection of debts be revoked; and if Guangxia Venture had already collected part of the debts, it should return them to Tonghe Holding; (4) That Tonghe Zhiye, Fuwo Company, and Guangxia Venture bear the litigation costs.

Additionally, it was found that in October 2007, Guangxia Venture transferred all its equity to Guangsha Share, and now Guangsha Share holds 100% equity in Tonghe Zhiye. According to Tonghe Zhiye's 2006 property statement, as of December 31, 2006, Tonghe Zhiye was in a loss position. However, Guangsha Share's 2007 semi-annual report stated that Tonghe Zhiye contributed a net profit of RMB 136,926,503.08 to the company during the reporting period.

Opinion of the Court of First Instance:

The court of first instance held that, as shareholders of Tonghe Holding, Hexin Company and Daxing Company, when the company was negligent in exercising its rights, had the right to initiate a derivative action pursuant to Article 152 of the Company Law of the PRC, and they had standing as plaintiffs. The lawsuit filed by Hexin Company and Daxing Company in this case involved three claims: payment of profit compensation, payment of equity transfer price, and rescission of the entrustment relationship. Although the claims were directed against three different entities, because the plaintiffs' claims were factually connected by the same subject matter of realizing the equity transfer payment, this constituted a necessary joinder of actions, and the case could be tried together.

Since Tonghe Zhiye, in accordance with the equity transfer framework agreement, should pay compensation to Tonghe Holding only if the company had generated profits, it should bear civil liability to pay compensation for the profitable portion. Fuwo Company, having failed to pay the equity transfer price in full to Tonghe Holding in accordance with the equity transfer agreement and the repayment agreement, should pay the actual outstanding amount and bear liability for damages. When Guangxia Venture accepted the entrustment from Tonghe Holding, it failed to truthfully disclose its related party relationship with Tonghe Zhiye, and after accepting the entrustment, it also failed to actively fulfill the obligations of the principal. Given that Tonghe Holding was negligent in exercising its right of arbitrary rescission, the plaintiffs' derivative lawsuit was justified. Accordingly, the court of first instance decided:

1. Tonghe Zhiye Investment Co., Ltd. shall, within 10 days from the date this judgment becomes effective, pay Tonghe Investment Holding Co., Ltd. compensation in the amount of RMB 130,080,177.93;

2. Shanghai Fuwo Enterprise Development Co., Ltd. shall, within 10 days from the date this judgment becomes effective, pay Tonghe Investment Holding Co., Ltd. an equity transfer payment of RMB 38.88 million and interest (from July 1, 2005 to November 10, 2006, calculation based on RMB 90 million at the annual interest rate of 8.5% as agreed in the repayment agreement; from November 11, 2006 until the date of full payment, calculation based on RMB 38.88 million at the annual interest rate of 8.5% as agreed in the repayment agreement);

3. The authorization granted by Tonghe Investment Holding Co., Ltd. to Guangxia Holding Venture Capital Co., Ltd. for entrusted collection of debts is revoked;

4. The other claims of the plaintiffs Zhejiang Hexin Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. and Jinhua Daxing Materials Co., Ltd. are rejected.

If the monetary payment obligation is not performed within the period specified in this judgment, interest on the debt for delayed performance shall be doubled in accordance with Article 229 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

The court acceptance fee for the first instance was RMB 1,802,760, of which RMB 901,380 was jointly borne by the plaintiffs Zhejiang Hexin Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. and Jinhua Daxing Materials Co., Ltd., RMB 630,966 was borne by the defendant Tonghe Zhiye Investment Co., Ltd., and RMB 270,414 was borne by the defendant Shanghai Fuwo Enterprise Development Co., Ltd.

During the second instance proceedings, with the mediation of this Court, the parties in this case, based on the principles of voluntariness and legality, through friendly negotiation, reached the following mediation agreement on March 17, 2009:

I. Agreement Regarding the Rights and Obligations among Hexin Company, Daxing Company, Tonghe Holding, and Tonghe Zhiye, Guangxia Venture.

Article 1: Amount and Method of Payment of Profit Compensation by Tonghe Zhiye.

1.1 After friendly negotiation, Hexin Company, Daxing Company, Tonghe Holding, and Tonghe Zhiye unanimously confirm: The actual net profit generated by Tonghe Zhiye has exceeded RMB 250 million, and Tonghe Zhiye shall pay Tonghe Holding a total profit compensation payment of RMB 237,500,000 (237.5 million). The parties unanimously agree that Tonghe Zhiye shall pay this profit compensation payment to Tonghe Holding in the form of additional profit distribution, i.e., after deducting the 25% corporate income tax payable on the RMB 237.5 million, Tonghe Zhiye shall pay Tonghe Holding RMB 178,125,000 (178.125 million).

1.2 Tonghe Zhiye shall, before June 30, 2009, provide Tonghe Holding with the following materials proving that the additional profit of RMB 178,125,000 (178.125 million) distributed by Tonghe Zhiye to its former shareholder Tonghe Holding has been fully taxed:

1.2.1 Two (2) originals of the resolution of Tonghe Zhiye's shareholders' meeting to distribute additional profit of RMB 178,125,000 (178.125 million) to its former shareholder Tonghe Holding.

1.2.2 Two (2) copies of the audit report of Tonghe Zhiye issued by a qualified auditing institution with securities practice qualifications, proving that at the time the shareholders' meeting passed the resolution to distribute additional profit of RMB 178,125,000 (178.125 million) to the former shareholder Tonghe Holding, the distributable profit of Tonghe Zhiye was greater than RMB 178,125,000 (178.125 million). (Each copy shall be stamped by Tonghe Zhiye to confirm that it is consistent with the original.)

1.2.3 Two (2) copies of the tax payment certificate proving that the additional profit of RMB 178,125,000 (178.125 million) distributed by Tonghe Zhiye to the former shareholder Tonghe Holding has been fully taxed. (Each copy shall be stamped by Tonghe Zhiye to confirm that it is consistent with the original.)

1.3 If Tonghe Zhiye fails to provide the materials specified in Article 1.2 of this agreement, and Tonghe Holding bears the tax liability for the profit compensation payment paid by Tonghe Zhiye, then Tonghe Zhiye shall, in addition to the RMB 178,125,000 (178.125 million), compensate Tonghe Holding for the taxes paid on the profit compensation payment. Tonghe Zhiye shall pay the aforementioned taxes to Tonghe Holding within 10 days after receiving notice from Tonghe Holding. If payment is overdue, liquidated damages shall be calculated from the date of default, with the amount of liquidated damages calculated as the tax payable by Tonghe Holding multiplied by four times the benchmark loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China for the corresponding period.

Article 2: Time for Payment of Profit Compensation by Tonghe Zhiye.

2.1  Tonghe Real Estate shall pay to Tonghe Holding 71.25 million yuan (71,250,000 yuan) on or before March 31, 2009, and the remaining 106.875 million yuan (106,875,000 yuan) shall be paid to Tonghe Holding on or before June 30, 2009. The parties hereto unanimously confirm that Tonghe Real Estate has paid 30 million yuan (30,000,000 yuan) to Tonghe Holding, and such 30 million yuan (30,000,000 yuan) shall be deducted from the aforesaid price accordingly.

2.2  If the after-tax profit compensation paid by Tonghe Real Estate to Tonghe Holding on or before March 31, 2009 is less than 71.25 million yuan (71,250,000 yuan), then Hexin Company, Daxing Company, and Tonghe Holding shall have the right to require Tonghe Real Estate and its guarantor to immediately pay the full amount of 178.125 million yuan (178,125,000 yuan) to Tonghe Holding, and shall have the right to apply to the people's court for compulsory enforcement of the property of Tonghe Real Estate and its guarantor, without being subject to the above installment payment agreement.

Article 3. Guarantee of Tonghe Real Estate's Payment Obligations.

3.1  Guangxia Venture voluntarily provides an irrevocable joint and several liability guarantee for Tonghe Real Estate's performance of the payment obligations under this Agreement, and waives the right to raise objections, defenses, and litigation with respect to all matters under this Agreement.

3.2  Guangxia Construction Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Guangxia Construction) voluntarily provides an irrevocable joint and several liability guarantee for Tonghe Real Estate's performance of the payment obligations under this Agreement, and waives the right to raise objections, defenses, and litigation with respect to all matters under this Agreement.

3.3  Mr. Lou Zhongfu voluntarily provides an irrevocable joint and several liability guarantee for Tonghe Real Estate's performance of the payment obligations under this Agreement, and waives the right to raise objections, defenses, and litigation with respect to all matters under this Agreement.

3.4  The scope of the guarantee provided in Sections 3.1 through 3.3 of this Agreement includes the following:

3.4.1  The after-tax profit compensation of 178.125 million yuan (178,125,000 yuan) payable by Tonghe Real Estate to Tonghe Holding;

3.4.2  The taxes and liquidated damages compensable by Tonghe Real Estate to Tonghe Holding pursuant to Section 1.3 of this Agreement;

3.4.3  The litigation costs payable by Tonghe Real Estate to Hexin Company and Daxing Company pursuant to Article 5 of this Agreement;

3.4.4  The liability for breach of contract to be borne by Tonghe Real Estate under this Agreement;

3.4.5  The expenses incurred by Hexin Company, Daxing Company, and Tonghe Holding in recovering the profit compensation and liquidated damages from Tonghe Real Estate.

Article 4. Revocation of Tonghe Holding's Authorization for Guangxia Venture to Collect Payments.

The parties hereto unanimously confirm that the resolution of the interim shareholders' meeting of Tonghe Holding on February 28, 2006 provided that Tonghe Holding authorized Guangxia Venture to collect due claims from Tonghe Real Estate and Fuwo Company on its behalf, and not that Tonghe Holding assigned or gratuitously donated the creditor's rights from such receivables of equity transfer proceeds to Guangxia Venture. Meanwhile, the parties hereto unanimously confirm that the agency authorization for Guangxia Venture to collect claims on behalf of Tonghe Holding terminated as of the date of the first-instance judgment (May 13, 2008).

Article 5. Allocation of Litigation Costs.

5.1  The litigation costs of 901,380 yuan borne by Hexin Company and Daxing Company in the first instance, and 630,966 yuan borne by Tonghe Real Estate, totaling 1,532,346 yuan (all of which have been advanced by Hexin Company and Daxing Company), shall be borne 70% by Tonghe Real Estate and 30% jointly by Hexin Company and Daxing Company, meaning Tonghe Real Estate bears 1,072,642.2 yuan and Hexin Company and Daxing Company jointly bear 459,703.8 yuan.

5.2  The second-instance litigation costs of Hexin Company and Daxing Company shall be borne 70% by Tonghe Real Estate and 30% jointly by Hexin Company and Daxing Company. Hexin Company and Daxing Company have paid a total of 2,570,870 yuan in second-instance litigation costs. Under the principle of halving litigation costs for cases concluded by mediation, the second-instance litigation costs for Hexin Company and Daxing Company are provisionally calculated at 1,285,435 yuan, so Tonghe Real Estate shall bear 899,804.5 yuan, and Hexin Company and Daxing Company shall jointly bear 385,630.5 yuan.

5.3  Based on the comprehensive calculation under the principles set forth in Sections 5.1 and 5.2 of this Agreement, Tonghe Real Estate shall bear 1,972,446.7 yuan (1,972,446.7 yuan) of the first-instance and second-instance litigation costs already paid by Hexin Company and Daxing Company. Tonghe Real Estate shall reimburse Hexin Company and Daxing Company the litigation costs of 1,972,446.7 yuan (1,972,446.7 yuan) within five days from the date of signing this Agreement.

5.4  If the Supreme People's Court finally determines the amount of the second-instance litigation costs for Hexin Company and Daxing Company to be inconsistent with the amount estimated in Section 5.2 of this Agreement (1,285,435 yuan), the amount of the second-instance litigation costs for Hexin Company and Daxing Company shall be based on the amount determined by the Supreme People's Court, with Tonghe Real Estate bearing 70% and Hexin Company and Daxing Company jointly bearing 30%.

5.5  The second-instance litigation costs of Tonghe Real Estate and Guangxia Venture shall be borne by Tonghe Real Estate and Guangxia Venture respectively.

Article 6. Liability for Breach of Contract.

6.1  If Tonghe Real Estate fails to pay the profit compensation within the time and period agreed in this Agreement, Tonghe Real Estate shall pay liquidated damages to Tonghe Holding, calculated by multiplying the unpaid amount by four times the benchmark interest rate for loans of the People's Bank of China for the same period.

6.2  If Tonghe Real Estate fails to pay the litigation costs to Hexin Company and Daxing Company within the time and period agreed in this Agreement, Tonghe Real Estate shall pay liquidated damages to Hexin Company and Daxing Company, calculated by multiplying the unpaid amount by four times the benchmark interest rate for loans of the People's Bank of China for the same period.

Article 7. Effectiveness and Miscellaneous.

The parties hereto undertake that this Agreement represents their true and free expression of intent. The parties unanimously agree that this Agreement shall take effect upon signature or seal by each party and upon adoption by the shareholders' meeting of Tonghe Holding or consent of the other shareholders of Tonghe Holding, and unanimously agree to submit this mediation agreement to the Supreme People's Court for review and to have a mediation document prepared.

II. Agreement Regarding the Rights and Obligations among Hexin Company, Daxing Company, Tonghe Holding, and Fuwo Company.

Article 1. Compliance with the First-Instance Judgment.

The parties unanimously express compliance with the second item of the first-instance judgment: "Shanghai Fuwo Enterprise Development Co., Ltd. shall, within 10 days from the effective date of this judgment, pay to Tonghe Investment Holding Co., Ltd. the equity transfer price of 38.88 million yuan and interest thereon (calculated from July 1, 2005 to November 10, 2006 on the amount of 90 million yuan at the annual interest rate of 8.5% as agreed in the repayment agreement; and from November 11, 2006 to the date of full payment on the amount of 38.88 million yuan at the annual interest rate of 8.5% as agreed in the repayment agreement)."

The parties unanimously express compliance with the part of the first-instance judgment ordering Fuwo Company to bear 270,414 yuan in case acceptance fees.

Article 2. Determination of the Amount of Fuwo Company's Debt to Tonghe Holding.

The parties unanimously confirm: Calculated in accordance with the method determined by the second item of the first-instance judgment, as of February 28, 2009, the total interest payable by Fuwo Company to Tonghe Holding is 18,272,450 yuan, and the total principal and interest is 57,152,450 yuan (fifty-seven million one hundred fifty-two thousand four hundred fifty yuan).

Article 3. Repayment of Fuwo Company's Debt to Tonghe Holding.

The parties unanimously agree that Fuwo Company shall use the proceeds from the transfer of its 37.64% equity interest in Shenzhen Hengxin Dewei Industrial Development Co., Ltd. to repay its debt to Tonghe Holding, and agree that the transferee of the equity shall directly pay 57,152,450 yuan (fifty-seven million one hundred fifty-two thousand four hundred fifty yuan) to Tonghe Holding, with the payment time no later than February 28, 2009.

The parties to this Agreement unanimously confirm that Fuwo Company has paid the full amount of 57,152,450 yuan (fifty-seven million one hundred fifty-two thousand four hundred fifty yuan) to Tonghe Holding.

Article 4. Payment of Litigation Costs.

Given that the litigation costs of 270,414 yuan (two hundred seventy thousand four hundred fourteen yuan) borne by Fuwo Company under the first-instance judgment have been prepaid by Hexin Company and Daxing Company, Fuwo Company shall reimburse Hexin Company and Daxing Company the litigation costs of 270,414 yuan (two hundred seventy thousand four hundred fourteen yuan) within five days from the date of signing this Agreement.

Article 5. The parties hereto undertake that this mediation agreement represents their true and free expression of intent. The parties unanimously agree that this Agreement shall take effect upon signature or seal by each party and upon adoption by the shareholders' meeting of Tonghe Holding or consent of the other shareholders of Tonghe Holding, and unanimously agree to submit this Agreement to the Supreme People's Court for review and to have a mediation document prepared.

Upon review, this Court holds that the above mediation agreement represents the true expression of intent of all parties on a voluntary basis and does not violate any prohibitive provisions of laws or administrative regulations. The content of the mediation agreement has not only been consented to by the shareholders bringing the derivative action, namely Hexin Company and Daxing Company, and the company as a third party in the action, namely Tonghe Holding, but has also been consented to in writing by all other shareholders of Tonghe Holding. Therefore, the mediation agreement does not harm the interests of Tonghe Holding or its shareholders. This Court hereby confirms the above mediation agreement.

This mediation document has the same legal effect as a judgment.

The first-instance case acceptance fee for this case is 1,802,760 yuan. Zhejiang Hexin Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. and Jinhua Daxing Materials Co., Ltd. jointly bear 459,703.8 yuan; Tonghe Real Estate Investment Co., Ltd. bears 1,072,642.2 yuan; Shanghai Fuwo Enterprise Development Co., Ltd. bears 270,414 yuan. The second instance of this case is concluded by mediation, and the case acceptance fee is reduced by half to 640,917.75 yuan.
